newsitem.title: UK: Futures fall leaves UK cash grains quiet, uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Futures fall leaves UK cash grains quiet, uncertain.

text.p: UK cash grain traders blamed lower futures for taking the steam out of the market.
"It's all over the place. Futures are down and it's hard to see where to price it," one said.
A fall in futures which started on Wednesday continued on Thursday.
"The market looked as though it might be getting a bit steadier," one said. "People looked ready to pay up and then wallop," he said. The buyers stepped back from the market.
The range of prices paid eased in comparison with Wednesday, but traders said the volume done had come down too.
